create_hparams_instance: create an HParams instance with hyperparameter name-value pairs like learning_rate and num_hidden_units
add_hparam_to_instance: add a hyperparameter name-value pair to an existing HParams instance
parse_hparams_from_string: parse comma-separated name=value pairs from a string to override HParams values
parse_hparams_from_json: parse a JSON string of name-value pairs to override HParams values
serialize_hparams_to_json: serialize HParams values into a JSON string representation
